method: Bounded read-only changed-seam review against the existing shipped Route, Job/validate_candidate, class proof, shared DRC/process/PRL readers, CliJob, queued bridge and publisher APIs. No imports, harness or validator execution.
checked: Exactly three controls and exact context/budget envelope are required; the draft remains non-executable. Both installed child and outer source are pinned; the outer reuses the reviewed production enclosure to bind the exact actual positive receipt, reaped positive enclosure, production protocol, installed context, regular Python and tools.

The positive remains at its real original absolute paths. Its raw receipt bytes, route/export receipts, complete material inventory, source files and prerequisites are freshly witnessed; full central positive route/export readback is performed before controls and in final_check, without a positive routing rerun.
Mismatch requires the exact ClassIdentityMismatch reason from the actual task-class netlist stage, with no engine step or engine log. An unrelated exception cannot qualify that control.

The short is appended to a fresh exact copy of the actual positive candidate using the same original project/SCH/PRL and protected routes. Shared validate_candidate automatically enables full schematic parity for the captured SCH. Own saved refill, final fullSCH DRC, conditional field evidence, effective classes, Native dimensions, original design and all ten protected items are replayed through existing public helpers.

The short predicate requires zero opens, exactly four errors with the complete expected type census and rejection-reason set, all six exact original warning rows, the original two ignored checks, and zero exclusions. Unexpected Native findings fail rather than being filtered.

The cancellation watcher is finite and joined. Qualification requires observation of a nonempty actual engine log before the engine journal, an actual cancelled engine process with SIGINT and matching journal, rejected/cancelled route output, all worker cleanup flags, no import or final proof, and central positive-reader refusal.

Intentional test cancellation only bypasses the cancelled CliJob live flag after those negative predicates pass. The independently queued external signal flag is always checked in phase_live/account and clears both positive control flags. Missing observation, timing races, worker failures or an unrelated reader outcome do not produce success.

Final publication uses exact completed material plus late DRC/field/class PRLs across controls and retained positive roots, including preview plot PRLs. Final semantic replay is followed by fresh material/PRL/live/deadline checks. Publisher invalidation or a late post-publication failure clears passed and controls_passed and preserves failed evidence.

The existing 238-second child wall/fullCPU, 245-second cooperative watchdog and 258-second outer wall/fullCPU bounds retain the mandatory external 260-second whole-command wall and user+systemCPU gate. Preparation/review are separate; nested samples are not additive. Existing inner resource/network and ownership guards remain unchanged.
qualification_limits: Expected error identities/counts, exact class refusal text and actual cancellation timing still require the one frozen lead execution; this source review does not establish their runtime outcome.

Central reader refusal of the cancelled result is supplementary: qualification also requires the specific actual engine/route cancellation evidence and absence of final proof. It is not an any-exception substitute for the Native predicates.

No new positive routing run, late-mutation duplicate, relocated Native history, new family, quality/comparison gain, actual GUI, human/electrical approval or whole-tree hard-kill cleanup qualification is supplied by this source draft.
